summary: Node 11 reassign leaves new pending rows; gate needs two apply cycles
description:
`insertReassignedTag` in guru-review/server/src/apply.ts marks the donor
`reassigned` and inserts the new tag at `status='pending'`. The node 11 gate
is "no pending rows remain for the text". So applying a queue that contains N
reassigns leaves exactly N new pending rows, the gate re-opens, and node 14
stays blocked behind it.

## Measured on yoga-sutras

The node 11 queue carried six reassigns. After the user applied it:

  book 01  3 pending (I.15 inner_silence, I.28 sacred_names, I.45 unity_of_being)   gate FAILS
  book 02  2 pending (II.10 inner_silence, II.43 sacred_names)                      gate FAILS
  book 03  0 pending                                                                gate PASSES
  book 04  1 pending (IV.31 unity_of_being)                                         gate FAILS

Book 03 is the only book whose tag pass produced no reassigns. That is the
entire difference.

The six `accept` actions that would close those rows (ra90701-ra90706) are
queued and unapplied, so a second apply cycle is required.

## Why this is a bug and not just a fact

1. A driver that reports "node 11 complete" after queueing is wrong, and the
   status machine will contradict it later. This happened in the 2026-08-09
   session.
2. The two-step is not documented anywhere the reviewer sees it at decision
   time — the guru-review-tags skill describes reassign as a single verdict.
3. It compounds: any future node 14 `retarget` (0b21d209) would inherit the
   same shape.

## Options

- apply could resolve reassign-inserted rows directly (accept them, since the
  reviewer already asserted the claim by reassigning) — simplest, and matches
  reviewer intent; the new row's `pending` status arguably encodes a review
  step nobody asked for
- or: keep the two-step but make `guru ingest status` distinguish "pending,
  never reviewed" from "pending, created by an applied reassign", so the gate
  message tells the truth
- or: leave the mechanism and document it (done, node 11 workbook) — but that
  leaves the gate lying about what is outstanding

Workbook entry added at docs/ingest/11-tag-review.md under Gate.
